people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Now, Yahweh God, let your promise to David my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
translations.bsb: Now, O LORD God, let Your promise to my father David be fulfilled. For You have made me king over a people as numerous as the dust of the earth.
translations.kjv: Now, O LORD God, let thy promise unto David my father be established: for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
translations.asv: Now, O Jehovah God, let thy promise unto David my father be established; for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
